name: Projexion
description:
Construction data lives in fourteen different systems. Procore holds the RFIs, Sage holds the cost, P6 holds the schedule, and the number your VP asked for lives in a spreadsheet somebody rebuilt last Thursday. Getting a straight answer about a project means chasing exports.

Projexion is the risk intelligence layer general contractors run on top of that stack. It connects to Procore, Sage 300 CRE, Autodesk, P6 and Excel, stays in sync nightly, and turns the whole portfolio into live dashboards and calculations your team actually trusts.

This connector puts it inside Claude, so you can ask instead of chase:

• "Which projects slipped this month, and what changed in the schedule?"
• "Pull cost-to-complete for the Riverside job and compare it to last quarter."
• "Show me open RFIs by subcontractor across the East Region."

Claude reads your live dashboards and widgets, runs your saved calculations across the entire portfolio, searches your projects and knowledgebase by meaning rather than exact name, and makes the updates you ask for — new records, edits, whatever your role already allows.

You sign in with your normal Projexion account and choose which of your accounts the connection may work in. From there Claude sees exactly what you see, and nothing more: every request is checked against your own user's permissions.

No migrations, no new system to learn, no data leaving the platform you already run. Your team keeps working the same way — the answers just arrive faster.

Requires a Projexion account: projexion.io

_published_faq.name: How do I add Projexion to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Projexion to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.projexion.io/api/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Projexion MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Projexion provides these MCP tools: execute_graphql, get_graphql_schema, get_skill, get_table_content, get_widget_content, list_accounts, list_integrations, run_calculation, search_knowledgebase, semantic_search, and validate_graphql.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Projexion?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Projexion in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Projexion requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Projexion is developed by Projexion, Inc. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
